_doc: Settings for the example-audio workflow (AUDIO_WORKFLOW.md). Changing tts_model, prompt_strategy, checkers, rule or mp3_kbps is a workflow change: rerun the regression suite (python3 build/audio_regression.py) first and log it in the AUDIO_WORKFLOW.md changelog.

production.reason: checker thinkingmachines/inkling rejects MP3 input since 2026-09-26 (OpenRouter error: 'unsupported audio format (only WAV is supported)'); every check returned n/a, so clips were accepted on three checkers and ~5-9% were left for a human. Resume after the checker gets WAV input (or is replaced), audio_regression.py passes and the changelog records it.

baseline._doc: Measured 2026-09-25 in je-dict-1: mean first-take rate of the Kore, Charon, Erinome and Iapetus pilots at 48 and 32 kbps (0.87-0.94, run-to-run noise about ±3 points on 100 sentences). Used to judge pilots (within 8 points) and production drift.
